activity.notes: Svatopluk took control of Great Moravia in 870 after Rastislav's fall. He was imprisoned by the East Franks in 871 and temporarily lost power, creating a genuine interruption that ATLAS preserves as a separate first Activity rather than flattening his rule into one continuous rail.

sources.title: Svatopluk — Hrvatska enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia identifies Svatopluk as ruler of Great Moravia from 870 to 894 and notes his temporary removal and restoration in 871.

sources.title: Svatopluk, principe della Grande Moravia — Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Svatopluk's seizure of Moravian government in 870, imprisonment in 871, and subsequent restoration.
